services.name: Group Tours
services.desc: (Scroll down for Private Tour information) Group Tours are available Tuesday through Sunday for organized groups consisting of a minimium 20, and maximum of 50, visitors. Group Tours include a Docent-led tour of the first floor of Whitehall and last about 45 minutes. In addition to a Docent-led tour of the first floor, the Flagler Museum offers three options for touring the second floor of Whitehall and the Flagler Kenan Pavilion and Railcar No. 91: Self-guide Brochures and Audio Tours in English, Spanish, German, French, and Portuguese; and the Flagler Museum Tour app in English, Spanish, and French. services.desc: Charles Courtney Curran (American, 1861 - 1942). Girl in Window Seat, 1892. Berg Family Collection, Image Courtesy of Eric Baumgartner. The Flagler Museum’s 2026 Spring Exhibition, Golden Hour: Charles Courtney Curran and the Romance of American Impressionism, traces the celebrated American painter’s journey from his Ohio roots to New York, Paris, and the mountaintop artists’ colony of Cragsmoor, New York, where he spent four decades capturing sunlit gardens, breezy mountaintops, and moments of quiet grace.
